headline: Three-player crews dig together — GravelYard's third seat goes online
lede: Join order seats the crew: host digs, first joiner drives the truck, second joiner works the screen console. Proven with three real headless browsers on one relay room and physical keystrokes, not just sims (PR #1719, gravelcheck 99/99) — and doing so caught that the shipped two-seat mode never actually ran: wire pads skipped the lockstep gate, and the pad normalizer erased the yard's mask, so every remote pad arrived empty and the twin gates passed vacuously. Both fixed, mutant-proven. Merge waits on the #601 freeze.

notes.text: #1705: 3-seat lockstep in src/utils/lockstep.js (opt-in per-slot pad/hash referee; legacy 2P path byte-identical, netcheck 39/39) + real browser netplay gates in gravelcheck (91→99).
Vacuous-green is the worst green: two empty pads hash equal. Gates must show the sim MOVED — a digger that drove on a wire pad, a gate that cycled from the console seat.

Kickoff gates need every box's room view: StrictMode's ghost socket on the relay let a host-only slots>=3 check seat a dead peer and freeze the shift live. Equal-instant hash sampling across 3 browsers is flaky-by-design; tick-spread/stall/convergence invariants are the honest lockstep proof.

#601 freeze holds and is now well-characterized: nightly #40+#41 (same head) failed the SAME 11 watchcheck gates — deterministic, local repro, bisect red already at batch-5. Likely these Y-gate/prover gates never went green in CI since watchcheck was wired into smoke (#1670). Full data, bisect and a correction posted on #601 for the QA lane.
